pcs.pc_description: identify the work order and is able to meet the timelines as specified by the supervisor
prioritizes and schedules the work in the most efficient order for the day, accounting for inventory, maintenance schedules, etc.
help with machine setup by ensuring that materials and tools are correct, available, and ready to use.
load materials and/or removes product to prevent bottlenecks from forming.
assist in the monitoring of production equipment, under direction, to ensure machine operation is within acceptable limits.
provide relevant information (e.g., inventory levels, production numbers, build records, etc.) in order to enable decision- makers to have reliable information for review.
ensure self and others use appropriate lifting and handling techniques according to Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards and SOPs
assess safest and most efficient way to move materials to appropriate destination(s)
select appropriate equipment to aid in material handling, as required.
ensure the availability of the material to run the order
follow quality processes to identify nonconforming materials
mix ingredients, according to procedure
load and unloads processing equipment or conveyance used to receive raw materials or to ship finished products
clean and lubricates equipment
replace damaged or worm equipment parts
turn valves to regulate flow of liquids or air, to reverse machine, to start pump, and to regulate equipment
mark or tags identification on parts
place or position equipment or partially assembled product for further processing, manually, or using hoist
adjust machine settings to complete tasks accurately according to specifications and in a timely fashion
perform pre-operation activities on one or more pieces of equipment to ensure proper start- up and operation
follow appropriate procedures for changing over the machine to prepare for next order
check output quality to ensure it is as per the instruction
clean machine and ensures that it is in safe and proper working order for the next shift

pcs.pc_description: report of materials ordered, materials used, and waste/scrap generated in order to ultimately reduce waste/scrap
categorizes waste according to SOPs and determines if waste is hazardous and/or regulated by legislation to ensure compliance
store the waste according to the waste characteristics and storage requirements
ensure all hazardous waste is labelled, stored, and/or sent to the correct location as per internal and external requirements to minimize harm to people and the environment
keep records to provide evidence that the waste is stored according to all requirements
remove product, machine attachments, and waste material from machine
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated

follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
practice good housekeeping in own area to reduce risk of injury to self and others.

ensures self and others use personal protective equipment (e.g., face masks, gloves, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, hearing protection, etc.).
inspect tools, materials, equipment, and machines prior to use for visible defects and informs appropriate personnel if damage found
report health and safety hazards, injuries, or concerns, including any unsafe machine practices, damaged equipment, and workplace harassment to supervisors.
interact (verbal, non-verbal and written) in a gender, disability, and culturally sensitive manner
promote a safe and interactive environment
